name: Entity Default Bundle
description: Default install bundle for Entity-aware agents and runtimes.

plugins.reason: Loads the required agent operating contracts for Entity FS links, source registry, MC completion, deploy discipline, and config safety.
Optional host-specific outbound message path rewriting implementation.

notes: Plugin-specific behaviors should be separate packages and added to bundles only when the installer explicitly wants them.
Discord thread title hooks are intentionally not part of this bundle.
